value.answer: This needs urgent medical care now - a fever like this in a baby under 3 months always needs to be checked right away, since young infants can get seriously ill quickly without other obvious signs.
value.triage: Go to the ER now or call 911 if your baby is hard to wake, floppy, struggling to breathe, or has a rash that does not fade with pressure. Otherwise, still take them to the ER or call 811 immediately for guidance - do not wait and watch with a fever this young.
